mutations.because: PT-8f3: a live campaign's latest version must carry no path ref — a path ref is a mismatch. Flipping the guard sends a path ref into the asset-id branch, which reads it as an id and reports the wrong reason.
command: a live campaign whose latest version still carries a path ref is an asset mismatch

mutations.because: PT-8f3: an imported campaign whose latest version was overwritten by a user must be a mismatch naming the actor. Flipping the comparison reports a mismatch when the actor is correct, so a clean org fails.
command: an imported campaign whose latest version was edited by a user is a campaign mismatch naming the actor

mutations.because: PT-8f3: verify exits 1 when any check mismatched. Returning 0 unconditionally hides a flipped-byte mismatch from the exit-code contract.
command: flipping one byte of a stored object makes verify exit 1 naming that asset

mutations.because: PT-8f3: no secret reaches ImportIO or --out. A redactSecrets that returns its input unchanged lets a configured password or S3 secret embedded in an error message reach stderr.
command: a store whose thrown error embeds the configured secrets redacts them on stderr
